name: Phoenix Burn (Combat, Style)
body:
Attackers must beware the fire in your body.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 15, Phoenix Style, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +11 or monk level 7th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. When you use Phoenix Style, you are surrounded by a nimbus of flame. Creatures that attack you must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or suffer damage as if they were hit by your elemental fist.
